english.title: Large brand owner, packer/filler, importer or service provider fail to comply with packaging waste reporting - England
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a large producer subject to obligations as

(A)_[a brand owner]_
(B)_[a packer/filler]_
(C)_[an importer]_
(D)_[a service provider]_

in regulation 17 of the Packaging Waste (Data Reporting) (England) Regulations 2023, failed to report the information in Part 2, Part 3 of, and paragraph 23 of Schedule 1 to, those regulations to the Environment Agency every 6 months in accordance with that regulation and in such form and manner as the Environment Agency directed in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 17(1)(a) and (b) and 28(2)(b) and (7) of the Packaging Waste (Data Reporting) (England) Regulations 2023.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: SI 2024/359 extended the specific large producers and records of information to be reported under this offence meaning this document should not be used after the 31st March 2024. For the offence applying after this date, see H101649.
